headline: JENNIE's 'Power Trip' lands on official 'GTA VI' album
sub: She's the only Korean artist on Rockstar's soundtrack album
caption:
BLACKPINK's JENNIE is officially part of the 'Grand Theft Auto VI' soundtrack with her song 'Power Trip'.

Rockstar Games released 'Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album' on Nov 19, and JENNIE is the only Korean artist on the tracklist. Her name first surfaced when the album's tracklist went public earlier this week, and now fans can finally hear the song.

📌 Source: Rockstar Games Newswire, via Korean media
